HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   C. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.

2. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.
   B. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

4. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.
   C. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   D. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

6. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.

7. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.

8. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.
   B. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.
   C. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.
   C. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

12. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.
   D. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Digital citizenship technology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Equality and Non-Discrimination Page 16 of 75 1 STRAND 1.0: THEMES IN KENYAN HIS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Equity and non- discrimination and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to History and Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
